BJ loved that scooter more than almost anything! Riff and Baby Bop decide to have a sale in the park to raise money to buy BJ a brand-new scooter.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ is pretending to be a great detective, and needs a mystery to solve! A case quickly comes his way when something nibbles on one of Baby Bops healthy snacks. BJ, Barney, and Baby Bop uncover several clues along the way and soon realize the culprit is someones pet rabbit. Barney sees Riff protecting a nest full of duck eggs. Together, they leave the eggs to look for food for when the ducklings hatch. When they return, Riff is pleasantly surprised to find the eggs have cracked open and the baby ducklings have hatched!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: While playing in the caboose, BJ is surprised to learn that The Land of Mother Goose truly exists. Several Mother Goose characters have come to ask for help; parts of their rhymes are missing! Mother Goose arrives and fixes the problem, and all of the Mother Goose characters return home. BJ and Baby Bop hope to visit them soon. When Baby Bop catches Barney, BJ, Riff and some children wrapping a mysterious present in the caboose, she just cant wait to see what is in the box. Barney suggests they listen to a story while they wait. Baby Bop finally gets to open her present and realizes that sometimes waiting is a good thing!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop isnt satisfied with the things she can do. She wants to play the keyboard like Riff and wants to be able to skate like Barney. Nobody can cheer her up, until she unexpectedly gets the whole park dancing and she realizes there are things she can do, too! When a wheelchair-bound child is unintentionally neglected by his friends, Barney steps in to help. He gently reminds the others to include the child by showing them that even Barney feels excluded sometimes. It isnt always easy being a big, purple dinosaur. In the end, everyone is included for a day of fun!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Jamal has never danced before and is too shy to try. On the day of the big dance party in the park, Barney and his friends introduce Jamal to many kinds of dance. Barney assures Jamal that he can do anything he puts his mind to even dance. With Barneys help, Jamal finally finds his groove and has fun dancing with his friends! Barney tells Baby Bop the story of The Princess Without a Song to Sing. In this original fairytale, Baby Bop imagines herself as the sad little princess trying to find her unique song. Barney, BJ and Riff all become characters in the story, each sharing their songs and revealing an element of song, sound, rhythm and feeling. With their help, the princess finds her song and is delighted to sing it for her friends!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff cant find his drumsticks anywhere. He knows he had them when he visited various neighborhood locations with Barney earlier in the day. Barney magically recreates neighborhood spots to help refresh Riffs memory. Happily, Barneys strategy is a success and Riff finds his drumsticks. Along the way, everyone learns that the most important part of a neighborhood is the people who live there! Barney helps Baby Bop explore many different jobs. At the end of the day, Baby Bop has several different careers to consider for when she grows up. But for now, shes happy just being three!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ is waiting for a very special letter from his pen pal in China. The letter reveals that his pen pal is coming for a visit. With the help of friends in the park, BJ hurries to get the park ready. He wants it decorated so his pen pal feels right at home. BJ soon learns that his pen pal wants to see how BJ really lives! Everyone is anxiously awaiting Mrs. Matumas Harambee Dance Troupe to arrive. They finally arrive and perform a show of African music and dance and everyone pulls together in the true spirit of Harambee!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Riff to the Rescue! - A Wild West Adventure
programme.desc: When Riff is asked to be captain of a baseball team, he doesnt think he can do it. But Barney gives him the courage to try, by recounting the tale of his great-great-grandfather Riffle the Wild West hero!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Lights! Camera! Action! - A Movie Adventure
programme.desc: Melanie comes up with the perfect idea to get people to donate to Grace's food drive - put on a movie premiere in the caboose! Barney and friends pitch in to help, but they all have different ideas about what kind of movie to make. Everything they try falls apart. It's curtains for Melanie's movie until she comes up with a blockbuster idea of her own.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: To Catch a Thief - A Mystery Adventure
programme.desc: Detective BJ is on the case when several sports balls suddenly disappear. Determined to find the mysterious ball thief, BJ falsely accuses Riff of being the thief. BJ learns he cannot jump to conclusions and must find the whole story to see who the thief really is.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Magic Lamp - A Travel Adventure
programme.desc: Celebrating her birthday in the park with friends, Layla is more interested in hot dogs than her mother's Middle Eastern food. When Barney reads the story of Aladdin and the Magic Lamp, Layla is transported to a Middle Eastern marketplace where she learns different cultures have many exciting foods and customs to offer.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Amazing Captain Pickles - A Hero Adventure
programme.desc: Captain Pickles and Wonder Princess both wanted to be the super-est superheroes. When Captain Pickles said he could jump over the moon, everyone wanted to see. BJ knew he couldn't really jump that high, but he could jump high enough to save Emma's balloon. Everyone was proud of him, even if he couldn't jump over the moon. BJ was a hero.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: A Game for Everyone - A Sports Adventure
programme.desc: Barney comes up with the idea to have a sports day in the park. All day, they play games like soccer and hopscotch among others, all for fun. Meanwhile, Baby Bop meets a girl with special needs named Jill, as well as her mom. As Baby Bop gets to know Jill more, she encourages her to play hopscotch with the others. In the end, Baby Bop and Jill win the trophy for hopscotch and she and her mother leave.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Reluctant Dragon - A Fairy Tale Adventure
programme.desc: After the kids judge a spider by its creepy looks, Barney tells them the story of The Reluctant Dragon where a shepherd became friends with a dragon, who was judged by her appearance.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop's friend Monty the butterfly passes through the park with a flock of friends on their way to Mexico. When Monty gets left behind, Barney takes everyone on a visit to Mexico to return Monty to his insect friends and family and give Baby Bop the chance to say goodbye to her butterfly friend.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney's excited to find out that Rusty's family is adopting a new baby sister from China; however, Rusty's not sure if he's going to be a good brother, and he doesn't know much about China. Barney shows Rusty and the others some info China on the computer and BJ and Baby Bop talk about siblings. Through Barney's Travel Book, Barney takes Rusty, BJ and Baby Bop on an adventure to China where he can learn more about his new sister's heritage. When they get there, the people are celebrating Chinese New Year. From lion dances and talented performers to tasty treats, making lanterns and puppet shows, the celebration never runs out of fun. By the time he returns to the park, Rusty excitedly meets his new baby sister, named Mei Ling, and realizes he will be the best big brother ever.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Ben is late to the park and is disappointed to realize he missed his chance at riding a real pony. He has waited his whole life for this, and now it looks as if hes missed his opportunity. Luckily, Barney takes Ben to Spain where they meet Regalo, a dancing horse with Riff and Baby Bop. Ben and Barney return to the park just in time for him to ride the pony after all! Ben is thrilled to ride a horse and learned an important lesson about patience and waiting.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Emma is stuck with a school project and can't play soccer with Joshua. Having to interview her parents and get info about an interesting ancestor, she is frustrated with the assignment. Barney helps her discover that her ancestors were from Venice, Italy. Using his Travel Book, Barney takes Joshua, Emma, and Riff to Venice, Italy. He gives his friends a gondola ride as well as telling them about famous explorer Marco Polo. Barney's friend, Anna Maria tells Emma that she knew her great grandfather and takes her to his shop, where they try on masks and make some of their own. Emma learns that if she makes the mask in parts, she'll get it done. Barney reminds her of this lesson, so she will do the same for her school project.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney, Baby Bop, and BJ are helping the kids get ready for a school play. Barney tells everyone that putting on shows began in Greece. Of course, the little dinos and kids want to visit the country, so off they go! While there, they meet some friends and decide to put on a play in an amphitheatre. Barney knows a great story that originated in Greece called King Midas. By the end of the day, everyone has learned that wanting too much is not a good thing, especially BJ!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Ben accidentally includes Kioko's prized music box from Switzerland in a cardboard box of yard sale items-the music box is sold! Kioko is sad and Ben wants to make things right, so he and Barney travel to Switzerland in search of a replacement gift. While there, they sample Swiss food, customs and games-but no music box! Luckily when Ben returns the music box is returned!

programme.title: Kims Video
programme.desc: Physical media reigns supreme in KIM’S VIDEO, a tribute to the iconic video store in NYC that inspired a generation of cinephiles before it mysteriously closed its doors and sent its legendary film archive to a small Sicilian village for “safekeeping.” What starts as an homage to cinema quickly becomes a rescue mission to ensure the eternal preservation of the beloved video collection. Directed by Ashley Sabin and David Redmon.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Drake
programme.desc: Two males visit a New Plymouth house in the middle of the night, staying only a few hours before they leave. The following day the occupants discover what they think is a body left in the garage. Police are called.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Keppel
programme.desc: An abandoned car is discovered in a quiet Hamilton street. Police are called and they find an envelope with money in it, an IOU note and a suitcase with women’s clothing in it. They trace the car’s owner as a young mother, Carmen Thomas, who lives in Auckland and hasn’t been seen for several days. Her ex-partner, Brad Callaghan, says that she missed a scheduled pick up of their young son and that he is concerned for her well-being.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Nadia
programme.desc: At 7.30am on a mild, summer morning, a middle-aged woman goes into her backyard to unlock the self-contained unit where her 23-year-old daughter lives alone. She lets her daughter’s dog out and notices a pair of overalls lying on the floor, half-in, half-out of the bedroom. The overalls should be with her daughter who, by now, would normally be on her way to work at a recycling facility. The woman takes a closer look and finds her daughter’s body lying face-down on the bedroom floor, cold. She calls out to her husband, they phone emergency services and the operator tells them to roll over their daughter - her throat has - been cut.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Edgewater
programme.desc: At 1.20am on a dark rainy Sunday morning the residents of a suburban street are woken by the sounds of a taxi crashing into a brick fence. There was no squealing of brakes. A witness rushes to help and finds the driver slumped over the steering wheel. He is bleeding profusely from wounds in his neck and chest, his foot is still pressing the accelerator, the engine still running.

programme.title: Forensics: Operation Davis
programme.desc: A teenage girl is dropped back at her family home at around 6pm on a Saturday evening after an overnight visit to a friend’s house. Her mum was away visiting relatives; her sister is due back home at 8am the next morning. She texts her sister to let her know she is safely home and spends the evening texting friends until just after 10pm. This is the last - time anyone ever hears from 15-year-old Marie Davis.

programme.title: When The LAPD Blows Up Your Neighborhood
programme.desc: Tensions rise on a busy street as news organizations and local residents witness an extremely volatile situation turn into a literal powder keg. Directed by Nathan Truesdell. A DOCUMENTARY+ Original film.

programme.title: Eat Flowers
programme.desc: Eat Flowers picks up in 2017 as photographer Cig Harvey’s best friend Mary is diagnosed with a rare form of leukemia. When forced to isolate during her treatment, she asks Cig to send her photographs. Everyday Cig sets out to bring color and life to Mary through her camera. Everyday Mary asks for more. ‘Eat Flowers’ brings us into the vibrant worlds that Cig creates for her. Directed by River Finlay

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars: Episode 1
programme.desc: Gordon arrives at the notorious HM Prison Brixton, in the hopes of taking non working prisoners and molding them into working cooks. Can Ramsay deal with offenders from murders to a man who was found with a shotgun under his bed?

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars: Episode 2
programme.desc: As Gordon's business gets busier, the prison's stringent systems and routines start getting to him, and he struggles to keep his brigade together. Serial offender Lawrence loses it in the kitchen and tries to attack another prisoner, and the authorities stop Jerome from being able to bake.

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars: Episode 3
programme.desc: After two months of success, Gordon now wants to expand the prisoner's food selections and go commercial. Meanwhile the team has dwindled down yet again.

programme.title: Gordon Behind Bars: Episode 4
programme.desc: The six months are up, the team is now even smaller, and everything is now on the line. Can it all be a success? Can lives be turned around? Will the program be allowed to continued?

programme.title: Elvis & Priscilla: Conditional Love
programme.desc: Elvis and Priscilla are one of the most famous celebrity couples of all time. But the story that lies beneath the glamorous facade is more toxic than what first meets the eye. Elvis has defined Pricilla's life. His comment that she was "young enough that he could train her any way he wanted,", in the end, came true. Though their relationship was bound by true love, what were the conditions that let it flourish? Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: Beyonce: Queen B
programme.desc: One of the most recognizable figures in contemporary music. Get lost in the ultimate story of modern day superstardom as we take you through the incredible journey of Beyoncé. Directed by Billy Simpson.

programme.title: Beyond Normal
programme.desc: In this intimate portrayal of resilience and self-discovery, professional surfer Becca Speak battles to reclaim her identity and return to the waves after a devastating brain injury suffered during a competition.

programme.title: Adele: Homecoming
programme.desc: Adele is a Grammy Award-winning artist whose soulful sound has thrust her into the limelight. Her soulful voice, frank personality and chart-topping hits have made her one of the most successful artists of all time. Her authenticity in her work appeals to so many; there are no gimmicks with Adele. What you see is what you get. Through her own words, video and live performances, this documentary takes an incredible look at the life and times of one of the greatest artists of all time. Directed by Billy Simpson.

programme.title: Selena Gomez: Devotion
programme.desc: After returning from her five year break from music, Selena Gomez has blown the world away with her third studio album Rare. She has transformed over the years, from Disney pop star to award winning film and tv producer. She is one of the biggest stars in Hollywood and is certain one of the most devoted to her art. This is the life and career of Selena Gomez. Directed by Matt Salmon.

programme.title: Elton John: A Life In Song
programme.desc: Elton John's career has spanned decades, but his legacy is more than just his music. Reginald Dwight's early debut was in the band Bluesology - there he would meet lyricist Bernie Taupin whom he would go on to write over 30 albums with. After parting ways with the band and his birth name, the Rocketman was born. Directed by Finlay Bald.

programme.title: David Bowie: Stardust
programme.desc: This documentary tells the story of how Bowie became one of the most iconic creations in the history of pop music. From his music, the fashion and the theatrical stage presents which turned Bowie into the biggest craze since the Beatles. Directed by Elena Carmen and Billy Simpson.

programme.title: The Barbie Story
programme.desc: Barbie is way more than just a 12-inches long piece of plastic, she is way more than a toy. The legendary blond bombshell has grown into a phenomenon and a children's sensation. Wildly revolutionary, Barbie broke barriers, shattered glass ceilings, and has inspired countless dreams, wonder and imagination. The history of the doll is a testament to its enduring appeal and impact. Things have changed for her the same way things changed for women. Whatever we may think about Barbie - love or loathe her - it is impossible to ignore her worldwide impact. Let's step into the beautiful world of Barbie and take a look at her cultural revolution through the decades. Directed by Roxane Schlumberger.

programme.title: Barbie's Pink World
programme.desc: She is plastic, she is fantastic. She's Barbie of course. But she is way more than just plastic, she is way more than a toy. The pretty blond has become a worldwide sensation especially after the blockbuster movie starring Margot Robbie and directed by Greta Gerwig. Barbie's been around for so long, but hasn't aged a day. She's had more than 200 different jobs; she's been president, she's been to the moon, and she's done all the things that women want to do. She has a massive closet, and thousands of stylish outfits. Barbie has inspired dreams, wonder and imagination, and, can you guess her favourite color? Welcome to Barbie's Pink World. Directed by Roxane Schlumberger.

programme.title: Life In Miniature
programme.desc: Kath Holden is an artist of the everyday. Inspired by the world around her, Kath's creations are whimsical yet keenly observed, and a far cry from the genteel museum pieces that her contemporaries are producing. A proud Yorkshire woman, Kath reflects on her life and art as she carves a place for herself in the precious world of miniatures. Directed by Ellen Evans.

programme.title: Princess Diana: Unexpected Icon
programme.desc: Diana Spencer was that quiet shy girl who every young lady could relate to. The difference with her is that she became a princess. From then on she shot up into stardom to become one of the biggest icons, not only in the UK, but in the entire world. Directed by Nick Randall.

programme.title: The Reagans
programme.desc: The Reagans forged a legacy as the first couple of the United States. This intimate portrait captures the Reagans' inspiring journey, historic partnership and touching love story. Directed by Robert Kline.

programme.title: The Untold History Of The United States: 1900-1920 - World War I, The Russian Revolution & Woodrow Wilson
programme.desc: A look back at the early 1900s, climaxing with WWI & the Russian Revolution as the mother of the ensuing conflict between the British, Soviet, and newborn American Empire. Directed by Oliver Stone.

programme.title: The Untold History Of The United States: 1920-1940 - Roosevelt, Hitler, Stalin: The Battle Of Ideas
programme.desc: The rise of Nazism and Adolph Hitler as the leader of Germany, the rise of Joseph Stalin as the Soviet leader and the election of Franklin D. Roosevelt as President of the United States. Directed by Oliver Stone.

programme.title: The Untold History Of The United States: World War II
programme.desc: This first chapter explores the birth of the American Empire by focusing on Franklin D. Roosevelt, Winston Churchill and Joseph Stalin. Directed by Oliver Stone.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: Expedition Wallacea
programme.desc: 150 years ago Alfred Wallace used his observations on Indonesian islands to develop a theory of evolution independently of Darwin’s. Now Matthias Kopfmüller’s team want to add to Wallace’s work: can the undersea evidence explain what Wallace found on land? What Wallace had recognised is that within a single island group there seemed to be a barrier that species could not pass.

programme.title: Urban Jungle
programme.desc: We think cities belong to us, but the concrete jungle’s teaming with animals - whether its monkeys in Japan, sparrows in Germany, Turkish rats or even Manatee in Florida. We make friends with some, but most go about their lives unseen. Some people see wild animals as pests, and dangerous to our health, others believe they are crucial to our well-being and belong here as much as we do.

programme.title: War Crimes of the Liberators
programme.desc: US soldiers fought for democracy and the freedom of other nations. Yet in the course of military operations, they too committed war crimes. Most of them never followed up on let alone punished. In the wake of the Allies’ advance against Hitler’s tyranny, there were numerous atrocities committed by the victors, not only in the East. Apart from their medals, some American soldiers also kept a dark secret. GIs killed German Prisoners of War and raped thousands of German women. Estimates of the number of German victims vary widely, and are highly disputed among experts. Not least because they touch on a taboo, since for decades in Germany the subject had been considered as a potential strain on the relation between the Federal Republic of Germany and its Western Allies. According to some historians there were several thousand sexual assaults by American soldiers in Bavaria alone when US forces liberated the region in April 1945. At some invasion beaches in Normandy, only every second germen POW survived. Often, the liberators – shocked by the sight of German atrocities – would fall into a spiral of violence. Very few of these crimes came under investigation by US military courts. Studies by the US War Department hinting at a comparatively high number of transgressions were classified secret.

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.title: Scotland - Highlands and Islands
programme.desc: Mysterious castles overlooking lonely lakes, and men in kilts playing the bagpipes; whiskey, and the Loch Ness monster: everybody is familiar with the clichés about Scotland. What few people realise, however, is that Great Britain‘s northernmost region also contains fascinating countryside and wildlife.

programme.title: Eagle Lakes
programme.desc: The Lauenburg Lake District is located between Lübeck and Lauenburg on the River Elbe. With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: Deserts On The Move
programme.desc: Most school textbooks continue to recite the conventional wisdom that Europe does not have any deserts. They are out of date. Portugal, Spain, Italy and Greece are four EU countries that are already so badly affected that they have joined the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (CCD).

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: Pioneers, Season 1
programme.desc: They are the Queens of the skies. Within minutes they reach heights of more than 30,000 feet. Soaring high above the clouds, travelling from place to place, these gigantic birds of shining steel cross seas, mountains and deserts, carrying millions of people around the globe. All this is made possible by high-performance jet engines.

programme.title: Zero Hour
programme.desc: At the end of the Second World War the cards in global politics were reshuffled. The Allies now made a clear distinction between the friends and foes of democracy. The situation became critical for Franco, because in Spain many suffered from his reign of terror. For that reason, there were many who wanted to topple him.

programme.title: Secret Societies
programme.desc: Since Dan Brown’s bestselling novel ‘Angels & Demons’, the secret society of the Illuminati has been known to millions. Founded in Ingolstadt in May 1776, the secret society was committed to changing the prevailing systems. The founder, Adam Weishaupt, was a renowned philosopher and theologian who didn’t just fight against the oppressive dogmas of the church, but also against the totalitarian forms of government that existed at the time.

programme.title: The Grand Trunk Road - From Kolkata to Peshawar
programme.desc: This journey takes us along the precolonial Grand Trunk Road, which stretches across the entire Indian subcontinent. We begin in the mangrove forests of the Bay of Bengal, moving on to Kolkata for the colourful religious festival Durga Puja.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: About twelve thousand years ago, before the Neolithic Revolution, humans were mainly hunter-gatherers. Among the animals we hunted were the wild aurochs, the ancestor of all domestic cattle. The domestication of cows led to the use of oxen as draught animals that could help farmers plough fields.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Throughout history, humans have surrounded themselves with animals. But there are two species that are our undeniable favourites. Every dog today was once a wolf - genetically speaking. Wolves and hominids met as early as 400,000 years ago. Ancient hunter-gatherers and wolves competed for the same prey, and used the same tracking techniques.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues
programme.desc: “... all the waters that were in the river [Nile] were turned to blood. And all the fish that was in the river died,” reports the Bible, “and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river.” (Exodus 7:20–21).

programme.title: Deserts On The Move
programme.desc: Most school textbooks continue to recite the conventional wisdom that Europe does not have any deserts. They are out of date. Portugal, Spain, Italy and Greece are four EU countries that are already so badly affected that they have joined the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (CCD).

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues
programme.desc: Although nine disastrous plagues had already devastated the land along the Nile, Pharaoh remained stubborn and would not release Moses and his people from slavery. And so their God, Yahweh, planned his final assault: At midnight, he sent death over Egypt – all the firstborn, Man or beats, had to die … there was no escape.

programme.title: War Crimes of the Liberators
programme.desc: US soldiers fought for democracy and the freedom of other nations. Yet in the course of military operations, they too committed war crimes. Most of them never followed up on let alone punished. In the wake of the Allies’ advance against Hitler’s tyranny, there were numerous atrocities committed by the victors, not only in the East. Apart from their medals, some American soldiers also kept a dark secret. GIs killed German Prisoners of War and raped thousands of German women. Estimates of the number of German victims vary widely, and are highly disputed among experts. Not least because they touch on a taboo, since for decades in Germany the subject had been considered as a potential strain on the relation between the Federal Republic of Germany and its Western Allies. According to some historians there were several thousand sexual assaults by American soldiers in Bavaria alone when US forces liberated the region in April 1945. At some invasion beaches in Normandy, only every second germen POW survived. Often, the liberators – shocked by the sight of German atrocities – would fall into a spiral of violence. Very few of these crimes came under investigation by US military courts. Studies by the US War Department hinting at a comparatively high number of transgressions were classified secret.

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Learn to Knit
programme.desc: Have you always wanted to learn how to Knit? Well nows your chance to have a lesson in the comfort of your own home. This easy to follow step by step programme will teach you the basics to get started and then move on to some simple projects such as making a scarf. You will find out what equipment you'll need, learn different knitting stitches and then finishing techiniques and some great tips for your future knitting projects!

programme.title: The Fruit Hunters
programme.desc: The Fruit Hunters travels across culture, history and geography to show how intertwined we are with the fruits we eat. The ranks of the fruit-obsessed include adventurers, scientists, fruit detectives and even movie star Bill Pullman, fruit hunters dedicating themselves to searching for and saving rare and exotic fruit, and to creating a Garden of Eden in a world increasingly dominated by industrialized monoculture.

programme.title: An Introduction to Tarot
programme.desc: Explore the mysteries and attraction of the ancient art of Tarot Cards. The cards might be centuries old but can still have an inexplicable power to help answer some of life's most important questions. In this programme we explain how to use the cards, shows the basic meaning of the pack and how to conduct a Tarot card reading. We conduct a reading and we can see for ourselves how to explain the possible card interpretations.

programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.desc: Join Ainsley in his kitchen where he is cooking up some relaxing and comforting food for those Lazy Sundays! On the menu for his Sunday brunch best are Sweetcorn Fritters with Avocado, Tomato & Black Bean Salsa & Poached Egg. Gyles Brandreth makes an appearance in his kitchen—showing Ainsley his take on the Fish Finger Sandwich. BOSH! are in their kitchen, showing Ainsley take on quick Custard Tarts for that Sunday sweet fix. And Ainsley indulges in a brunch cocktail favourite—his Bloody Mary with Polenta Mozzarella Sticks and finishing off the Sunday menu with his Rosemary & Anchovy Slow Roasted Lamb with Roasted Roots.

programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.desc: Ainsley is in his kitchen inspired by the dishes from the pub menu—what beats a pint of ice-cold beer and a natter with your friends? The dishes available on the menu! Ainsley starts with an all-time favourite Sausage & Mustard Mash with Onion & Red Wine Gravy. Great British Bake-Off favourite Selasi Gbormittah joins him in the kitchen and shows Ainsley his sumptuous and indulgent Hazelnut Profiteroles. - The lovely Candice Brown shows her take on a bar snack classic, with a Ham Hock & Apple Scotch Egg. And Ainsley shows us his take on Cheesy Bean Nachos & Guacamole, and a Sensational Steak Sandwich with Blue Cheese Mayo to finish!

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: In Essex, co-owner and chef of Toulouse, Stefan has engaged his sous chef Billy to help him kick off the week with some restaurant classics. However, the starter of King scallops and veggie option goat's cheese salad comes under fire from Indian couple Kaps and Satin, who run The Bull and Willow room, a traditional country pub, and it is clear that they could be the picky couple of the week

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today’s Come Dine With Me: The Professionals comes from Essex and kicking off the competition is chef and owner Billy and his manager Sam, who are confident their original vegan BBQ menu will bag them the grand.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Exeter chicken joint, Eat the Bird, begin today’s competition with owner Dan and head chef Luke risking it all with their fried chicken fayre.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: Wild game and squid ink make for an exciting opening round, and it’s curry in a hurry when the home cooks create dishes using the South Asian ingredients in Chef Meeru Dhalwala’s fridge.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: An unconventional approach to a Middle Eastern favourite has the chefs questioning one home cook’s ability to please a crowd, and the strong flavours of blue cheese, broccoli, and chorizo in Chef Mandel Hitzer’s fridge have everyone struggling to create a cohesive dish.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: An episode to make the kids happy, learn to make nutty chocolate pops, a luscious chocolate and meringue cake, ice cream with a Lamington twist or caramel filled choc nut cups - the options are endless.

programme.title: Karena & Kasey's Foreign Flavours
programme.desc: Where most people only visit Bali, Karena and Kasey head to the Indonesian capital of Jakarta to learn about one of the most miss-understood cuisines. - They get to taste the joys of a padang restaurant and then head to Bandung, known as the Paris of Java, to sample street food cuisine and meet celebrity chef, Bandung Bob. - The week finishes back in Jakarta with a glitzy function for the who’s who of the Indonesian food scene.

programme.title: Karena & Kasey's Foreign Flavours
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey land in Chile’s capital, Santiago, where Karena meets two chefs from acclaimed restaurant Peumayen, who show her how Chilean cuisine is moving forward by going back to it’s ancestral past. Kasey heads to the port town of Valparaiso, home of the famous seafood market, and tracks down the infamous ‘caldillo de congrio’ dish. - For their final challenge, they travel to the island of Chiloe where some say the ‘Hangi’ originated from and cook for a group of local Huilliche-Mapuche people.

programme.title: Ainsley's Food We Love
programme.desc: Join Ainsley in his kitchen where it’s time for that Great British tradition—tea! Ainsley puts a modern twist on that old King of dessert trolley, with Black Forest Brownies with Kirsch Cream. And actor, singer, and dancer John Partridge visits Ainsley in the kitchen, where he bakes up a storm with his Sausage Rolls. - The lovely Candice Brown adds a naughty twist to teatime with her Gin & Tonic Drizzle Cake, accompanied with some Rocky Road Cookies. And Ainsley gets his savoury bake on with Cheesy Chive & Bacon Muffins, followed by some savoury Afternoon Tea Tartlets.

programme.title: Episodio 107
programme.desc: Kotufa, ansiosa por aclararle a Salvador que su abuela actuó por su propia voluntad, lo llama al celular y descubre que Laly se encuentra con él cenando y tomando bebidas, esto enloquece a la joven y explota en rabia. Carlota trata de calificar su relación y le pregunta a Guillermo cuáles son sus intensiones con ella, éste no sabe que contestarle, porque ni él lo conoce la respuesta. Marivi recibe a su marido en el restaurant a la hora acordada, y de inmediato ella le propone agregar a la cita, una botella de vino como lo hacían antes, y le encarga su plato favorito, él más distante trata de no involucrarse mucho, pero aun así, acepta.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Hechizo de Amor
programme.desc: Ligia Valderrama (Emma Rabbe) es la hermosa y engreída hija de una familia adinerada que vive en la capital. Pero existen secretos que yacen bajo la fachada de una familia feliz. La mujer que ella considera su madre no es la que le dio la vida, y su verdadera madre está internada en un manicomio. A algunas horas de camino del hogar de Ligia vive otra bella mujer con un pasado diferente. Ella es una pobre huérfana criada por una pareja que la adoptó cuando sus padres murieron. Ambas mujeres conocen y se enamoran de los hombres de sus sueños, pero a ninguna se le permite casarse. En cambio, ambas parejas son obligadas a separarse y por un tiempo pareciera que ambas jóvenes se casarían con la pareja de la otra.

programme.desc: Titina, muy despechada, se dedica a emborracharse y a bailar con Tamanaco a modo de rehén, pero sin mucho disgusto. Kotufa sigue instalada en la casa de Máximo, cuando llega Marivi para llevarla a la casa, pero la tarea es muy difícil, ya que tesista está decidida a pasar la noche allí. Cristóbal llama a Canelón para armar un operativo para buscar a su mujer, de inmediato éste inicia la búsqueda. Ya en el auto, Titina y Tamanaco se trenzan en abrazos y besos, preparándose a todo, cuando una patrulla llega al lugar y los detiene, y pese al intento del guardaespaldas de llegar a un acuerdo, todo es en vano, y para peor la intervención de ella tratando de sobornar a los oficiales, dictan el apresamiento de la pareja.

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Pitufo Sobre Ruedas
programme.desc: Cada año, todos los Pitufos recorren la larga senda hasta llegar a unos manantiales termales de ensueño. Sin embargo, este año únicamente Abuelo Pitufo, Papá Pitufo y Pitufo Natural harán la caminata hasta ese lugar. Los demás Pitufos están demasiado atareados (o son demasiado vagos) como para caminar. Entonces, Pitufo Carpintero llega con lo que él llama su pitufurgón personalizado. Ya no es necesario andar: basta con ir sobre ruedas hasta allí… Por supuesto, las cosas no serán tan sencillas como parecen.

programme.title: Conociendo El Futuro
programme.desc: Baltasar el encantador es un hombre con visión. Sabe que la era de la alquimia está llegando a su fin. El futuro pertenecerá a aquellos que comprendan la ciencia, pero… ¿cómo puede conocer el futuro? Quizá secuestrando a Padre Tiempo. Los Pitufos ayudarán a arreglar la situación después de que Pequeño Trueno, un dinosaurio, escape a través de una rotura en el tejido del tiempo.

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Todo Esta Bien Si Termina Bien
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su plan por librarse de los Pitufos, Gargamel le lanza un hechizo a Gigantón y se disfraza de Pitufo. Creyendo que es un Pitufo, Gigantón está a punto de destrozar por completo la Aldea Pitufa hasta que Papá Pitufo acude con una cura.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Soñador desea encontrar vida extraterrestre pero en la Aldea se burlan de él. Nadie le creerá cuando les diga que ha hablado con un ser de otro planeta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel consigue transformar una colcha en una alfombra voladora, lo que hace inevitable que se produzcan accidentes. El resultado de uno de esos accidentes es que un trozo de la tela voladora acaba utilizándose como pañal para Bebé Pitufo, con resultados realmente sorprendentes…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pantano de Greenpeedeepee es el único lugar donde se pueden encontrar unas algas que son el delicioso e imprescindible ingrediente del famoso estofado de algas de Pitufo Goloso. Desafortunadamente, también es un lugar donde te puedes topar con los desagradables Verrugosos. A pesar de que Sasita y los Pitufos le salvan la vida a un joven Verrugoso, acaban siendo apresados por los demás. ¡Pero el Enmascarado Escarlata los salvará! Quizá…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: El Pitufo Osado
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel tiene un plan infalible. Sin hacer caso de la risa burlona de Azrael, el malvado hechicero ha perfeccionado una sustancia mágica a la que ha llamado «polvo temerario», que convertirá a todos los Pitufos en temerarios e intrépidos aventureros. ¿Caerá Papá Pitufo en la trampa de Gargamel? ¿Atrapará su enemigo a todos los Pitufos? ¿Tendrá esta historia un final feliz?

programme.title: Ya No Tengo Miedo
programme.desc: Una vez más, el infalible plan de Gargamel para atrapar a los Pitufos ha fracasado. Los Pitufos aprovechan para gastarle una broma: disfrazados de pequeños ángeles azules, le enseñarán a enmendar su conducta…

programme.title: Ya Pitufaron Al Cachorro
programme.desc: Los Pitufos están tan absortos con el nuevo juguete de Pitufo Carpintero que se olvidan de dar de comer a Puppy. Gargamel atrae a Puppy hacia una jaula con comida y le mantiene cautivo para pedir un rescate: los secretos mágicos de los Pitufos. Los Pitufitos distraen a Gargamel con el juguete durante el tiempo necesario para rescatar a Puppy, y prometen no volver a dejarlo desatendido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa extraña rana parlante que ha hecho que el hechicero Morlock haya enviado a todos los soldados del príncipe Teodoro para capturarla? ¿Es una rana demonio, como él dice? ¿O quizá lo hace por otro motivo? La verdad se desvelará cuando Pitufina y los Pitufitos se encuentran con la rana. Ayudan a la rana a volver a transformarse en el príncipe Teodoro, que había sido víctima de un hechizo lanzado por Morlock.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Fiesta De Pijamas Para Perezoso
programme.desc: ¡Pobre Pitufo Perezoso! Todo lo que desea es una buena noche de descanso. Pero no: todos los Pitufos celebran una fiesta en su honor y, lo que es peor, se ve arrastrado a una absurda discusión sobre pintar los dedos de los pies de Gigantón de un brillante color mandarina. ¡Va a ser una larga noche en vela para el pobre Pitufo Perezoso!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Ómnibus regala a los Pitufos un perro al que llaman Puppy. A este animal juguetón y de tamaño normal le gusta su nuevo hogar, pero Baltasar lo captura, creyendo que los secretos mágicos de los Pitufos están escondidos en el collar de Puppy. Los Pitufos rescatan al perro y lo único que Bebé Pitufo encuentra en el medallón del collar es música.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel roba el reloj de arena de Padre Tiempo con la intención de viajar al pasado y destruir a los Pitufos, a quienes culpa de que su vida sea un fracaso. Sus planes se ven frustrados cuando aparece Gigantón y rompe el hechizo, que solo duraría mientras nadie viera a Gargamel.

programme.title: Secreto Del Pozo De La Aldea
programme.desc: ¿Por qué Pitufo Torpe espera día y noche junto al pozo de la aldea? ¿Cuál es el deseo que quiere mantener en secreto? ¿Y cómo está involucrado Gargamel en este asunto misterioso? ¿Logrará Gargamel atrapar por fin a los Pitufos?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una aventura dramática y conmovedora… Pitufina y su mascota Re chillido. La pequeña Pitufina está inundada en lágrimas. ¿Podrán los demás pitufos consolarla?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Pitufo Marco Y Los Piratas Pimienta
programme.desc: Los Pitufos navegan para salvar a Marco, que ha sido capturado por el Capitán Pedro Pimienta. Marina y un delfín acaban liberando a Marco.

programme.title: La Pitufo Sinfonía
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía tiene prohibido tocar en la Aldea Pitufo y Gargamel aprovecha para engañarlo e intentar capturar Pitufos con un hechizo musical.

programme.title: Peligro En La Aldea
programme.desc: El pérfido mago Gargamel está harto de la constante superioridad de los Pitufos. Decide destruir su aldea de una vez por todas. Con ese fin, entrena una termita para que destroce, demuela, devaste y destruya todas las casas que se encuentre en su camino. Sin embargo, los efectos son mucho peores de lo que Gargamel había imaginado, ya que los Pitufos creen que las travesuras de los Pitufitos son las que están destruyendo su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Monstruosos
programme.desc: Es la noche de los fantasmas y todos los Pitufos se preparan para la elegante fiesta de disfraces… pero Pitufo Filósofo se hace con el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo y todos los Pitufos se transforman en criaturas horrendas, aunque divertidas. No obstante, el peligro acecha…

programme.title: Regalo Para El Dia De Papá Pitufo
programme.desc: Gargamel ha robado el gorro de cumpleaños de Papá Pitufo para atraer a los Pitufos hacia una trampa. Papá Pitufo, tras engañar a Gargamel para que los libere, guarda ese gorro tan especial para que todos recuerden esa gran fuga.

programme.title: Símbolos De Sabiduría
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está desesperado por parecerse más a Papá Pitufo. ¿Podría ser la respuesta un tónico capilar? ¿Conseguirá Gargamel capturar por fin a los Pitufos? ¿Reside realmente la sabiduría en una barba?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una emergencia, todos los Pitufos de la aldea dejan lo que tienen entre manos y corren a oír las noticias. Pero que Pitufo Vanidoso convoque una asamblea para que los Pitufos puedan admirar su nuevo gorro es pasarse de la raya. Le echan de la aldea y Pitufo Vanidoso tiene la mala suerte de encontrarse con Lofty, el elfo, que le recomienda darse un horrible baño de fango…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la mañana, antes de que los demás Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la mañana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Después, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demás Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Así pues, Pitufo Goloso renuncia. La aldea está en problemas… y pronto, también lo está Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Deshollinador se encarga de limpiar las chimeneas y no es precisamente el habitante más popular de la Aldea Pitufa. Es bastante desaliñado, y las nubes de hollín que suelta no contribuyen a aumentar su popularidad. Únicamente los Pitufitos le consideran una excelente compañía, ya que es el único Pitufo que puede ensuciarse sin que le riñan. Sin embargo, el entusiasmo de los Pitufitos por Pitufo Deshollinador pone en peligro la aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: Ya No Tengo Miedo
programme.desc: Una vez más, el infalible plan de Gargamel para atrapar a los Pitufos ha fracasado. Los Pitufos aprovechan para gastarle una broma: disfrazados de pequeños ángeles azules, le enseñarán a enmendar su conducta…

programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: La Belleza Es Superficial
programme.desc: Periwinkle, un hada vanidosa, se molesta cuando su espejo mágico le dice que el ser más hermoso es Pitufo Vanidoso, y no ella. Periwinkle secuestra a Pitufo Vanidoso, pero los demás Pitufos acuden al rescate. Periwinkle se da cuenta de que ha obrado mal y se convierten en amigos.

programme.title: Cuidando A Pies Grandes
programme.desc: ¿Recuerdas al ogro Gigantón y a su encantadora esposa Narizota? Ahora tienen un bebé: el pequeño (según los estándares de los ogros) Pies Grandes. Como a los Pitufitos no les permiten cuidar de Bebé Pitufo, Pitufo Colérico, Pitufo Blandengue, Pitufo Natural y la siempre dispuesta Sasita se ofrecen a vigilar a Pies Grandes mientras sus padres están en el baile de los ogros. Los Pitufitos conseguirán más de lo que esperaban…

programme.title: Campanas De Boda Para Gargamel
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se hacen amigos de una dama en apuros que está prometida a Gargamel, ya que convencen a su padre de que el estúpido mago está loco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina ha encontrado a una nueva amiga, Laura, una niña de seis años de edad cuyos padres viven cerca del bosque. Juntas, las dos niñas se pasean por el bosque. Pero una vieja bruja que vive en el bosque las captura.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Fiesta De Pijamas Para Perezoso
programme.desc: ¡Pobre Pitufo Perezoso! Todo lo que desea es una buena noche de descanso. Pero no: todos los Pitufos celebran una fiesta en su honor y, lo que es peor, se ve arrastrado a una absurda discusión sobre pintar los dedos de los pies de Gigantón de un brillante color mandarina. ¡Va a ser una larga noche en vela para el pobre Pitufo Perezoso!

programme.title: El Capricho De Travieso
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay un premio para aquel Pitufo que tenga la mascota más adorable. Bebé Pitufo acude con Cariño Dorado, una mascota adorable y cariñosa de la que todo el mundo se enamora. Sin embargo, esa mascota es una creación del malvado mago Gargamel con la que pretende destruir a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colérico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papá Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son mágicos y pueden cuidar de sí mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantarle y salvar a Pitufo Colérico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aman las trufas y las trufas son de los Trolls. No será nada fácil que los pitufitos azules tengan un banquete.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La primavera provoca que todos los Pitufos estén compitiendo por el amor de Pitufina y Gargamel decide hechizarla para que le ayuda a capturarlos. Papá Pitufo toma cartas en el asunto y con la ayuda del despistado gato Azrael consigue darle la vuelta al plan.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El rey Symphonium envía a su pelícano Satchelmouth para capturar a la orquesta de Pitufo Filósofo y llevar a todos hasta su isla. Pitufo Soñador se pone al timón de un barco y se hace a la mar para rescatarlos. Cuando Pitufo Soñador se marea, Pitufo Filósofo toma el mando y encabeza el equipo de rescate que libera a los Pitufos capturados.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La repulsiva bruja Hogata captura a Pitufina. Quiere robarle a la pequeña belleza azul su cabello dorado. ¿Conseguirán salvar los Pitufos a su pequeña compañera antes de que sea demasiado tarde? ¿Logrará Hogata una cabellera como la de Pitufina?

programme.title: Educando A Gigantón
programme.desc: Después de que Narizota echara a Gigantón de casa, los Pitufos intentan enseñarle a ser romántico, tener buenos modales y conseguir un trabajo. Aunque regresa a ella refinado, encuentra a Dientes cortejando a Narizota. Narizota se da cuenta de que le echaba de menos y acepta a Gigantón de vuelta para vivir felices para siempre.

programme.title: La Reina Pitufina
programme.desc: Pitufina se convierte en reina por un día en su cumpleaños. Sin embargo, la situación se descontrola cuando Padre Tiempo se queda dormido y no cumple su cometido de terminar los días. Los ánimos comienzan a calentarse entre los Pitufos, que están cansados de trabajar. Papá Pitufo acude a despertar a Padre Tiempo y trae de vuelta la paz a la tierra de los Pitufos.

programme.title: Sorpresa Para Sassette
programme.desc: A veces, los pequeños actos pueden tener grandes consecuencias. Mientras intentaba atrapar a Sasita, Gargamel altera la Balanza de la Verdad y, desde ese momento, todos los habitantes del mundo comienzan a mentir. Incluso Papá Pitufo se ha convertido en un mentiroso compulsivo. Y, por si eso fuera poco, el espíritu de la balanza ha encadenado juntos a Gargamel y Sasita, que deberán volver a colocar en su sitio el Topacio de la Verdad…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie le cree al Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extrañas tribus… Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto crédito a sus historias. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real mágico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pantano de Greenpeedeepee es el único lugar donde se pueden encontrar unas algas que son el delicioso e imprescindible ingrediente del famoso estofado de algas de Pitufo Goloso. Desafortunadamente, también es un lugar donde te puedes topar con los desagradables Verrugosos. A pesar de que Sasita y los Pitufos le salvan la vida a un joven Verrugoso, acaban siendo apresados por los demás. ¡Pero el Enmascarado Escarlata los salvará! Quizá…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Pitufo En Rascacielos
programme.desc: Está claro que una aldea de casas con forma de seta es bonita y alegre… Sin embargo, no resulta muy moderna a los ojos de Pitufo Arquitecto. Lo que los Pitufos necesitan es un rascacielos, un nuevo y atrevido concepto que cambiará su forma de vivir para siempre…

programme.title: El Capricho De Travieso
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel y Baltasar se ponen a los mandos de un Robotín gigante para obligar al rey Gerard a que les entregue a Pitufo Robotín. Cuando el Robotín está a punto de destruir el castillo, Gigantón, el nuevo, enorme y extraño amigo de Pitufo Robotín, vence al Robotín. Pitufo Robotín sufre daños durante la batalla, pero Pitufo Carpintero lo arregla y le implanta una caja de voz que le permite decir «¡Hola!».

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la fórmula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompañar a Pitufina. Así pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su poción, Papá Pitufo convierte la malvada creación de Gargamel en una simpática Sassette.

programme.title: Pituplicación
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel crea una fórmula mágica que duplica todo aquello que toca. Y…¡sorpresa! ¡Ahora hay seis Pitufos Filósofos! Esto provoca algunas situaciones interesantes en la aldea… ¡Y también en casa de Gargamel!

programme.title: Dirty Deal
programme.desc: Chief Madu goes around making ruthless deals with people but never making good on his part of the bargain. When he is killed after taking things one step too far, the investigation into his death gets complicated with too many suspects.

programme.title: Blood Bond
programme.desc: Ema and Steve are struggling with childlessness and become suspicious when a boy and a girl barge into their home claiming to be their children. They do everything in their power to prove the kids wrong.

programme.title: Private Matters
programme.desc: When swinging couple, Angela and Michael, move into a new neighborhood, their promiscuous lifestyle becomes a sick charade and spins out of control.

programme.title: Love Across
programme.desc: Coming out of a very bad marriage, Osas is trying to pick the pieces of her life together and find means to emotionally and mentally take care of her children. When she meets a younger man, Dafe who falls deeply for her, everything looks new as she experiences true joy and love.

programme.title: Double Wahala
programme.desc: When her sugar daddy develops a heart attack and suddenly dies in her apartment during a romp, a young woman must find the quickest way possible to dump his body without raising suspicion. Help comes in the form of her neighbour, a yahoo-yahoo boy who masquerades as a native doctor, but when the chief’s body disappears, what was a previous case of small trouble suddenly becomes double wahala.

programme.title: Number 1 Pastor
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. Eze was not called by God, but by money when he realizes how much money pastors are making. He decides to venture into the ministry, guising as a pastor, and develops a plan to get money. He plants listening devices in the houses of his church members and pretending to prophesy what he listens in on. His ministry grows big but he soon catches the attention of Shalewa , a young investigative journalist who is desperate for her big break and she decides to do a piece on him.

programme.title: Dark Horse
programme.desc: Imelda's father vehemently disapproves of her relationahip with her new boyfriend, causing a rift within their family. Is he just over-protective or is there something more sinister behind his behaviour?

programme.title: Ambiguity
programme.desc: A sugar daddy/sugar baby arrangement goes wrong when a promise made in the heat of passion leads to blackmail and a man finds himself labelled as a rapist in the public eye.

programme.title: AMC Red Carpet - Leather Fair
programme.desc: AMC Red Carpet brings you exclusive red carpet interviews with Nollywood stars at the premieres of top Nollywood movies and other industry events such as award ceremonies.

programme.title: The Three Brides
programme.desc: Kayode loves women as much as he loves to lie about how much money he has. Now, he has become the most eligible bachelor in town and women want to keep him by all means. Unaware of kayode’s true pocket status, the women fight over maintaining their position in kayode’s life. Empowered by their charms, the women get kayode to fall in love with all three of them at the same time. But is kayode the man these women truly want to be with?

programme.title: Who Is Perfect
programme.desc: Gift's perception of marriage is forever altered during her childhood after her father takes their maid as his second wife after 20years of marriage, breaking her mother's heart. This causes Gift to be distructful and when she gets married, she refuses to get a maid to help despite calls for it from her husband, Ubong.

programme.title: Pains Of Rhoda
programme.desc: A woman whose husband is sterile goes through a lot of emotional ups and downs as she tries to console him during their trying time but, his trust issues causes more problems instead.

programme.title: Rekindle
programme.desc: Kofi meets Iris, a beautiful woman during her vacation to Ghana and becomes infatuated with her, but she leaves him without leaving any information as to where she can be reached. When he goes to Nigeria to visit, he is surprised to be greeted by a familiar face claiming to be his cousin, Frank’s fiancé.
